_comment: Investigation system data for Episode 7: Justice. A murder mystery on Destiny. A crew member is found dead — Eli must gather clues, interrogate suspects with lie detection, and make an accusation. Faction tension escalates based on the investigation's direction and outcome.

scenario.title: Justice
scenario.cause_of_death: Blunt force trauma to the head. The body was found beside an open power conduit panel.
scenario.true_motive: Ginn had discovered Simeon's secret communications with a Lucian Alliance cell. He killed her to prevent the information from reaching Young.
scenario.description: Dr Ginn is found dead in the Engineering Bay. The evidence points toward Simeon of the Lucian Alliance, but the investigation must be thorough — a false accusation will tear the crew apart.

conduit_panel.label: Open Power Conduit Panel
conduit_panel.description: The power conduit panel beside the body is open. There are scorch marks on the casing — it was forced open recently, not by Ginn's keycard.

blood_trail.label: Blood Trail
blood_trail.description: A trail of blood leads from the body toward the aft corridor — not toward the science section where Ginn worked, but toward the lower decks where the Lucian Alliance members are quartered.

kino_recording.label: Kino Recording
kino_recording.description: A Kino that was deployed in the Engineering Bay recorded the last 30 minutes before the murder. The footage shows a figure in dark clothing entering through the aft access hatch — too tall to be Ginn, and moving with military precision.

alliance_knife.label: Lucian Alliance Knife
alliance_knife.description: A Lucian Alliance combat knife is found hidden behind the conduit panel — not the murder weapon, but planted to be found. The serial number matches a batch issued to Simeon's unit.

ginn_data_pad.label: Ginn's Data Pad
ginn_data_pad.description: Ginn's personal data pad, found under her body. The last accessed file was a decrypted communication log — entries to an unknown Lucian Alliance frequency. The last entry was timestamped 30 minutes before her death.

rush_testimony.label: Rush's Testimony
rush_testimony.description: Dr Rush reports that Ginn came to him two days ago, concerned about anomalous power fluctuations she traced to the lower deck relay — the same relay near the Lucian Alliance quarters. She suspected someone was sending unauthorized signals.

varro_alibi.label: Varro's Alibi
varro_alibi.description: Varro claims he was in the mess hall with Camille during the time of the murder. Camille confirms this — but only for the 30 minutes before the body was found, not the estimated time of death.

simeon_whereabouts.label: Simeon's Whereabouts
simeon_whereabouts.description: No one can account for Simeon's location during the estimated time of death. His quarters were empty, and he was seen returning from the lower deck corridor 15 minutes after the body was discovered — sweating, with fresh scratches on his forearms.

Simeon.description: Lucian Alliance soldier. Hostile, opportunistic, dangerous.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Simeon
dialogue_tree.text: You want to talk to me? About what? I had nothing to do with whatever happened to Ginn.

choices.text: Where were you when Ginn was killed?
We found your knife at the scene.
Ginn discovered your communications. We know.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Simeon
dialogue_tree.text: I was in my quarters. Alone. I don't need an alibi — I don't answer to you people.
dialogue_tree.lie_indicator: His eyes dart toward the door. His breathing quickens. He's hiding something.

choices.text: Witnesses saw you returning from the lower deck corridor.
That's not what the evidence says.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Simeon
dialogue_tree.text: That knife could belong to anyone in the Alliance. You're grasping.
dialogue_tree.lie_indicator: He tries to sound dismissive, but his hand twitches toward his belt — the exact spot where the knife sheath would be.

choices.text: The serial number matches your unit's batch.
Then explain the blood trail to your quarters.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Simeon
dialogue_tree.text: Communications? What communications? Ginn was a scientist, not a spy.
dialogue_tree.lie_indicator: His jaw tightens. He knows exactly what Ginn found — his reaction is too sharp for someone who claims ignorance.

choices.text: Her data pad has the logs. 30 minutes before she died.
You killed her to keep your secret.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Simeon
dialogue_tree.text: ...You have nothing. Circumstantial evidence. The word of a dead woman's data pad. I want to speak to Varro.

choices.text: This is over, Simeon.

Varro.description: Lucian Alliance commander. Pragmatic, cooperative when it suits him.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Varro
dialogue_tree.text: Ginn's death is a tragedy. She was one of the few scientists who treated us as people, not prisoners. I want to help find whoever did this.

choices.text: Where were you during the murder?
Do you know where Simeon was?
Was Ginn investigating anything unusual?

dialogue_tree.speaker: Varro
dialogue_tree.text: I was in the mess hall with Camille. She can confirm — we were discussing the alliance's role aboard Destiny. I left when the alarm sounded.

choices.text: Camille confirmed your alibi, but only for part of the time.
Thank you for being straightforward.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Varro
dialogue_tree.text: Simeon? He keeps to himself. He's been... agitated lately. More than usual. I assumed it was the confinement getting to him.

choices.text: Agitated how? Did he say anything specific?
Would Simeon kill to protect Alliance secrets?

dialogue_tree.speaker: Varro
dialogue_tree.text: Ginn had been asking questions about our communication protocols. She seemed... concerned. I told her what I could, but I didn't think much of it at the time.

choices.text: Did she mention any specific frequencies or contacts?
Simeon has his own communications equipment?

dialogue_tree.speaker: Varro
dialogue_tree.text: I see. Then there is a gap in my alibi. I won't lie to you — I left the mess hall briefly to use the head. Five minutes, maybe ten. But I returned before the alarm.

choices.text: Did you see anyone in the corridor during that time?
I appreciate your honesty, Varro.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Varro
dialogue_tree.text: If Simeon is responsible, it changes everything for us. The Alliance members aboard Destiny are not his personal army. We want justice too.

choices.text: I'll keep that in mind.

Dr Rush.description: Chief scientist. Brilliant, secretive, always pursuing his own agenda.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Dr Rush
dialogue_tree.text: Ginn came to me two days ago. She was troubled — said she'd traced anomalous power fluctuations to the lower deck relay. I told her to report it to Young. She didn't.

choices.text: Why didn't you report it yourself?
Did you suspect foul play?
What was she investigating exactly?

dialogue_tree.speaker: Dr Rush
dialogue_tree.text: I had other priorities. The ship's systems don't pause for internal politics. In hindsight, perhaps I should have acted. But I didn't kill her, Eli.

choices.text: Where were you when she was killed?
That's a cold response, Rush.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Dr Rush
dialogue_tree.text: I suspected someone was using the ship's systems without authorization. I assumed it was one of the Alliance members — they have the technical knowledge, if not the access codes. Ginn was... brave. Too brave, perhaps.

choices.text: You think Simeon did it?
You could have protected her.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Dr Rush
dialogue_tree.text: I was in the control interface room. Brody and Volker can confirm — we were running diagnostics on the FTL drive. I didn't leave until the alarm sounded.

choices.text: Thank you, Rush. That's all I need.

Brody.description: Engineer and scientist. Practical, reliable, a bit dry.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Brody
dialogue_tree.text: I found her. Came in for the morning shift and there she was. I didn't touch anything — I called for help immediately.

choices.text: Did you notice anything unusual?
Was the conduit panel already open?
Where was Rush that morning?

dialogue_tree.speaker: Brody
dialogue_tree.text: The conduit panel was open. That's odd — Ginn was meticulous about safety protocols. She would never leave a live panel exposed. Someone else opened it.

choices.text: Could the panel have been opened by force?
Who has access to the engineering bay?

dialogue_tree.speaker: Brody
dialogue_tree.text: Yes, the panel was forced. The locking mechanism was damaged — not bypassed with a keycard. Whoever did it was strong and in a hurry.

choices.text: That points to someone with combat training.

dialogue_tree.speaker: Brody
dialogue_tree.text: Rush was in the control room with me and Volker all morning. He didn't leave. He's cold, Eli, but he's not a killer. Look at the Alliance — Simeon specifically. He's been on edge for days.

choices.text: Thanks, Brody. That's helpful.

Simeon.label: Accuse Simeon
Simeon.description: Present the evidence against Simeon: the knife, the blood trail, the Kino recording, the data pad. Let Young decide.

outcome_correct.narrative: The evidence is overwhelming. Simeon is taken into custody. Varro expresses gratitude that justice was served — the Alliance members are not monsters. Tension between factions eases, slightly.

outcome_insufficient_evidence.narrative: Young dismisses the accusation — there isn't enough evidence to convict. Simeon walks free, and the crew loses faith in Eli's judgment. Faction tensions worsen.

Varro.label: Accuse Varro
Varro.description: Present the evidence against Varro — the blood trail toward the lower decks, the gap in his alibi.

outcome_correct.narrative: This should never happen — Varro is innocent. If reached, it means the logic failed.

outcome_wrong.narrative: Varro is innocent, and the crew knows it. The false accusation shatters trust between the Alliance and the rest of the crew. Varro is furious. The real killer remains free.

Dr Rush.label: Accuse Dr Rush
Dr Rush.description: Present the evidence against Rush — his coldness, his failure to report Ginn's findings, his access to the engineering bay.

outcome_correct.narrative: This should never happen — Rush is innocent. If reached, it means the logic failed.

outcome_wrong.narrative: Rush is innocent — Brody and Volker confirm his alibi. The false accusation damages Eli's credibility and alienates the science team. Rush is characteristically unforgiving.

lie_detection.description: Eli's Kino can be used to record interrogations. The Kino's Ancient technology can detect micro-expressions and physiological stress responses, revealing when a suspect is lying.
lie_detection.no_kino_text: [No Kino] Deploy a Kino to enable lie detection during interrogation.
